name: ST NUCLEO-G0B1RE (Nucleo-64)
description: Nucleo-64 for the feature-rich STM32G0B1: 64 MHz Cortex-M0+, 512 KB flash, USB FS, UCPD (USB-C PD) and 2 FDCAN, with ST-LINK/V2-1 and Arduino Uno V3 headers.
notes: The MCU has 2x FDCAN, USB FS device/host and UCPD, but the board fits no CAN transceiver; add an external PHY. USB/UCPD pins are on the morpho headers - check the schematic before assuming a user USB-C connector is fitted.
ST-LINK/V2-1 gives drag-and-drop flashing, a virtual COM port and SWD debug.
Price is the ST eStore list price seen in late 2026 (US tariff-era pricing); older articles quote lower numbers, so re-check before ordering.
